comment: What CI fetches to restore the gitignored Unity/Assets/Art/Imported images (D-1300). webRepo/webCommit: the web game at the commit the Unity rebuild is pinned to (Tools/export/sources.json core2.webSha is its short form); its tools/fetch-art.mjs downloads the art release its art-release.json pins. artTag must equal that pin's tag. Bump all three together when the pin moves.
